title.narrative: Tailor-made heat maps for Caribbean Island States - a climate resilience tool for enhanced decision-making

description.narrative: The proposed project, aligned with UNESCO's 42C/5 Draft Document and Budget for 2024-2025, seeks funding to implement satellite-based mapping for climate heat maps in Caribbean small island states. By enhancing spatial understanding of heat impact, this initiative aims to empower stakeholders and citizens in developing targeted strategies for climate resilience. Key project outcomes include bolstering evidence-based decision-making through heightened climate data accessibility and fostering public awareness of climate effects amidst rising temperatures for Caribbean small island states. This endeavor aligns with UNESCO's commitment to sustainable development, providing a tool for mitigation and adaptation concerning the adverse impacts of climate change on vulnerable island communities.
